verses.html: A Song of degrees. Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
verses.text: A Song of degrees. Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
verses.title: A Song of degrees.

verses.html: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
verses.text: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

verses.html: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
verses.text: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

verses.html: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
verses.text: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

verses.html: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
verses.text: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

verses.html: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
verses.text: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.

verses.html: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
verses.text: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.

verses.html: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
verses.text: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
